title: E-GRV-0101: on a husk backed by shrinking layers the pull's front outruns light by about the zero mode's 1.30, fail...
purpose: Experiment E-GRV-0101 in the gravity arena: on a husk backed by shrinking layers the pull's front outruns light by about the zero mode's 1.30, fail on D2: after a hop nothing changes on the next beat and the first change stays inside the link cone, but the front's first 10 percent reads 1.26 c and its first 25 percent 1.40 c (the half maximum is swamped by the static shift near the hop), because every layer beats one clock so the coarser layers carry waves faster in husk docks; 15 hops of 4 units over 4,096 beats keep Gauss, curl 0, 0 wraps and reverse bit for bit, the largest husk step flat at 0.80 .. 0.87; lumps fall alike to 3.7e-12 at -5.04e-4 per unit content; energy drifts 1.4e-5 of the static at three digits.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
